items.rule_gloss: A ponds of B fry each, shared equally over C release points; the temple pier already had D fish.
items.gloss_en: The riverside farm has {A} ponds with {B} fry each. All fry are released equally at {C} points along the river, the temple pier among them. The temple pier already had {D} fish. The upstream farm has {T} ponds but has released none. After the release, how many fish are at the temple pier?

items.rule_gloss: Early-season A days plus mid-season B days, times the daily net change C snowfall minus D melt (negative when melt wins).
items.gloss_en: The foothill station records {T} cm of new snow per day. The summit station watches {A} early-season days and {B} mid-season days. Each of those days the summit gets {C} cm of new snow and loses {D} cm to melting. Over the early and mid season, by how many cm does the summit snow depth change in total, counting snowfall minus melt?
items.notes: Signed: net change is negative when melt exceeds snowfall.
